data.one_liner: Simplify Flutter animations without dealing with AnimationControllers, Tweens, or explicit Tickers.
data.what_it_does: Provides a wrapper class EzAnimation that simplifies defining and controlling animations, sequences, and special tweens without boilerplate. It manages lifecycle details like navigation events and ticker setup through straightforward helper constructors.
use_when: You want to create custom animations quickly without managing AnimationControllers or Tickers manually.
You need to build sequential animations or use specialized tweens like ColorTween with minimal boilerplate.
avoid_when: You prefer completely declarative or physics-based animation paradigms.
You need complex choreography across multiple distinct controllers that require fine-grained low-level control.
strengths: Removes boilerplate associated with AnimationControllers and TickerProvidermixins.
Supports animation sequences and custom tweens like ColorTween out of the box.
Includes navigation handling to pause or reset animations when navigating away.
weaknesses: Using EzAnimation without context or vsync can be less performant.
Paused animations sometimes need to be manually restarted upon returning to the screen depending on the setup method.
